title.en: The access matrix and public space

aim.en: You can map pedestrian circulation, tactile guide paths, urban furniture, and calculate total distances and travel times for different user profiles in an access matrix.
aim.sr: Umeš da mapiraš pešačke tokove, taktilne staze vodilje, urbani mobilijar i izračunaš dužine putanja i vreme kretanja za različite profile korisnika u matrici pristupa.

bring.en: Slope map from week 7, tracing paper or CAD layer, drafting pens.
bring.sr: Karta nagiba iz 7. nedelje, paus papir ili CAD sloj, crtaći pribor.

items.sr: Održan je prvi kolokvijum sa predajom razvojnih skica, tehničkih crteža i prototipova iz oba zadatka — prototip igračke i reciklaža tekstila. Zavedeno je 11 studentskih predaja u 15 galerija (9 prototipova igračaka i 6 tekstilnih radova, ukupno 48 fotografija i tabli).
items.en: The first midterm was held with submissions of developmental sketches, technical drawings and prototypes across both tracks — toy prototype and textile recycling. 11 student submissions are recorded in 15 galleries (9 toy prototypes and 6 textile works, 48 photographs and plates in all).

items.sr: Svaki predati rad otvara sopstvenu galeriju sa svim prikazima i povezan je sa studentskim dosijeom u Dnevniku.
items.en: Each submitted work opens its own gallery with all views and is linked to the student’s record in the Journal.

text.en: Week 8 — Midterm 1: 11 submissions in 15 galleries (48 views)
One route for all: computing the access matrix
text.sr: Jedan put za sve: proračun matrice pristupa

text.en: Equitable use means no segregated entrances or detour tracks. In the access matrix, every user profile is calculated: distance from arrival, vertical rise, rest stops, and travel time. Separate pathways are an automatic design failure.
text.sr: Ravnopravna upotreba znači da nema odvojenih ulaza ni zaobilaznih staza. U matrici pristupa računamo svaki profil: dužinu od dolaska, uspon, odmorišta i vreme kretanja. Razdvajanje staza je automatski pad projekta.

items.en: If a wheelchair user must travel 280 m while an ambulatory visitor travels 40 m, can that still be called universal design?
items.sr: Ako korisnik kolica mora da pređe 280 m dok osoba bez teškoća prelazi 40 m, može li se to uopšte nazvati univerzalnim dizajnom?

revizije.izvor: Profesor predmeta, 27.11.2026. (kolokvijumske predaje 8 studenata sa osmog časa 20.11.2026).

sta.sr: Nedelja 8 je održana 20.11.2026. kao prvi kolokvijum; zavedeno je 8 studentskih predaja u 12 galerija (6 prototipova igračaka i 6 radova iz reciklaže tekstila, 42 fotografije i table). Pripremljeni blokovi ostaju na strani, ispod zapisa sa časa.
sta.en: Week 8 was held on 20 November 2026 as the first midterm; 8 student submissions are recorded in 12 galleries (6 toy prototypes and 6 textile-recycling works, 42 photographs and plates). The prepared blocks remain on the page, below the record of the class.

sta.en: Updated the eighth-class record with a 9th submission (gallery “Geometric grid puzzle”, 2 photographs) — 9 student submissions in 13 galleries (7 toy prototypes and 6 textile works, 44 photographs and plates in all).
